Dear Prado team,

I am excited to apply for the Digital Marketeer position at Prado. With a strong foundation in digital marketing, SEO, and web development, I am eager to contribute to your fast-growing ecosystem of home technology solutions.

In my current role as Junior Digital Marketer at Episto, I manage on-page SEO, create keyword-targeted content, and build and maintain WordPress sites. I have hands-on experience with Google Analytics, Google Search Console, SEMrush, Ahrefs, and Google Ads, and I am comfortable with A/B testing and data-driven optimization. My own project, mirook.com, showcases my ability to implement structured data and technical SEO/GEO audits to improve visibility across both traditional and AI-powered search engines.

I am particularly drawn to Prado's innovative approach and international growth. I am fluent in English, have a B1 level in Dutch (currently improving), and am eager to work in a collaborative, ambitious team. I am confident that my skills in campaign execution, analytics, and e-commerce support align well with your needs.

Thank you for considering my application. I look forward to the opportunity to discuss how I can contribute to Prado's growth.

cover_letter:
Dear Prado team,

I am writing to express my strong interest in the Digital Marketeer position at Prado. With a solid foundation in digital marketing, SEO, and web development, I am excited about the opportunity to contribute to your innovative ecosystem of home technology solutions and support your rapid expansion across global markets.

In my current role as Junior Digital Marketer at Episto, I have gained hands-on experience in executing and optimizing digital campaigns. I manage on-page SEO for client websites, from keyword research to publishing, and write keyword-targeted content that drives organic traffic. I also build and maintain WordPress sites using Elementor and Astra, ensuring seamless user experiences. My daily toolkit includes Google Analytics, Google Search Console, SEMrush, Ahrefs, and Google Ads, which I use to monitor performance and identify improvement opportunities. I am comfortable with A/B testing and data-driven decision-making, skills that are essential for optimizing ad creatives, landing pages, and audience targeting.

Beyond my professional experience, I have developed mirook.com, a project where I designed and built a multi-page WordPress site for a Belgian youth chess champion. This project allowed me to implement structured data (JSON-LD schema), entity optimization, and technical SEO/GEO audits, significantly improving the site's visibility across both traditional and AI-powered search engines. This hands-on project demonstrates my proactive approach and ability to work independently.

I am particularly drawn to Prado's family-driven philosophy and ambitious growth story. I am fluent in English, have a B1 level in Dutch (currently improving), and am eager to collaborate with a dedicated marketing team of ten professionals. I am confident that my skills in campaign execution, analytics, and e-commerce support align well with your needs.

Thank you for considering my application. I look forward to the opportunity to discuss how I can contribute to Prado's continued success.

Baver Ok
Digital Marketing · SEO · GEO · Content · Web
Zwijndrecht, Belgium | +32 470 42 48 36 | baverok@gmail.com | linkedin.com/in/baverok

## Profile
Junior digital marketer with a technical foundation in web design, SEO, and GEO (Generative Engine Optimization). At Episto, I run on-page SEO, keyword-targeted content, and full-cycle WordPress site build and maintenance for client sites. On my own project (mirook.com) I've applied structured data, entity optimization, and technical SEO/GEO audits to improve visibility across both traditional and AI-powered search engines. Comfortable across content management, social media coordination, and performance reporting; quick to pick up new tools and platforms, and growing into analytics, e-commerce content management, and campaign support. Based in Zwijndrecht, next to Antwerp. Works in English and Turkish; Dutch: B1, currently taking classes to improve further.

## Core Skills
- SEO & GEO: on-page SEO, keyword research, technical SEO audits, structured data / JSON-LD schema, entity optimization, GEO & AEO (AI search visibility)
- Content & CMS: SEO blog & content writing, editorial content publishing, website content management, WordPress site building
- Web & build: WordPress, Elementor, Astra theme, responsive web design, Canva, AI-assisted content tools
- Analytics & reporting: Google Analytics, Google Search Console, SEMrush, Ahrefs, Google Ads
- Social: social media content & integration
- Languages: English (professional), Turkish (native), Dutch (B1)

## Experience

### Junior Digital Marketer — Episto (Remote), 2026–present
- Own on-page SEO for client websites, from keyword research to publishing, improving organic visibility and search rankings
- Write keyword-targeted blog content for client websites to grow organic traffic
- Build and maintain client websites in WordPress using Elementor and the Astra theme, including content uploads and page updates
- Track site performance with SEMrush, Ahrefs, Google Analytics, Google Search Console, and Google Ads to guide SEO and content decisions

### Warehouse & Logistics — Katoen Natie (Antwerp), 2025–2026
- Maintained accuracy and efficiency in a high-volume, fast-paced logistics environment

### Front-End Developer — ViviDoctor (Belgium), 2018–2019
- Developed and optimized front-end features for a healthcare web application (AngularJS, JavaScript)

## Projects

### mirook.com — Website Design, SEO & GEO (2025–present)
- Designed and built a multi-page WordPress site (Elementor, Astra) for a Belgian youth chess champion: full site structure, on-page SEO, and social media integration (Instagram/Facebook)
- Implemented structured data (JSON-LD schema, including SportsEvent and FAQPage), entity/knowledge-graph markup, and an llms.txt file to improve visibility across traditional and AI-powered search engines (GEO/AEO)
- Ran iterative technical SEO/GEO audits, measurably raising the site's overall search-health score

## Education
